li.label: midsummer bonfire
li.description: We lit a bonfire higher than the roof and sang, badly, until it burned down.

li.label: beautiful flames
li.description: Did you see how high it went? Did you see the colors?

li.label: no celebration
li.description: No celebration this year. It was just another day of work.

li.label: harvest home
li.description: The harvest is in, and we celebrated with a big meal. We'll be fine this winter.

li.label: a warm midwinter
li.description: We spent the longest night of the year together, warm and well fed.

li.label: midwinter stories
li.description: We sat up late on midwinter night, telling stories about where we came from.

li.label: a year named after me
li.description: They named this year after me. I've said it out loud a few times, just to hear it.

li.label: someone's vanity indulged
li.description: They named a whole year after one of us, and it's gone to their head.

li.label: a year for those we lost
li.description: We named this year for the ones we lost.

li.label: the year of the muffalo
li.description: We named the year after a muffalo. I laughed until I cried, and the muffalo didn't care at all.

li.label: first pick of the spoils
li.description: I fought hardest, and I got first pick. As it should be.

li.label: someone grabbed the best spoils
li.description: We all fought. One of us got the good boots.

li.label: fair shares
li.description: The spoils were split evenly between us. That's fair.

li.label: graves even for raiders
li.description: They came to kill us, and we still gave them graves.

li.label: bodies left for the animals
li.description: We left them out there for the scavengers. I can hear it at night.

li.label: victory feast
li.description: We beat them, then sat down to a feast. I'm alive and my belly's full.

li.label: they made me let my animal go
li.description: The council had my animal turned loose in the wild. I keep looking at the treeline.

li.label: hair in the stew
li.description: There's animal hair in everything I eat now. The council decided that was fine.

li.label: a tradition kept
li.description: We kept up our tradition, the way we do every year.

li.label: a tradition broken
li.description: We've kept that tradition every year until now. It doesn't feel right to let it go.
